description: Rewrites the campaign's own texts around facts that already changed, and only the parts the host picked. WITHOUT `confirm` true nothing is written: the answer is the preview of which parts would be rewritten, one line each, so the host can pick. With `confirm` true the chosen parts are rewritten by the same copy writer the build uses, the untouched parts stay exactly as they were, and the answer names what really changed. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and `targets`. Facts move FIRST: a date with wi_change_webinar_schedule, the name with wi_change_webinar_title, a single wording with wi_change_webinar_text. This tool never moves a date or a title, it only rewrites copy around facts that already stand. For ONE wording use wi_change_webinar_text, which is exact and costs nothing.

confirm.description: true actually rewrites the chosen parts. Leave it out to get the preview first and let the host pick.

primary_goal.description: What should be different for the participants afterwards, if that changed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

target_audience.description: Who the webinar is for, if that changed.

targets.description: Which parts to rewrite: registration page copy, thank-you page, the emails, the title, the room info text, or all of them.

topic.description: The topic, if it changed and the new copy should know it.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_rewrite_webinar_texts
title: Rewrite the webinar texts after the facts changed
